products.name: Invoice Follow-Up Queue
products.product: A polite, evidence-based reminder workflow for independent service businesses managing unpaid invoices.
products.audience: freelancers and independent professional service businesses
products.problem: Payment reminders depend on memory, while invoice delivery, client questions, promises, disputes, and next actions remain scattered.
products.valueProposition: Creates a clear reminder sequence that pauses for questions, records payment promises, and stops immediately on resolution.
products.topic: freelancer invoice follow-up and overdue payment reminders
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets overdue invoice reminder, freelancer payment follow-up email, unpaid invoice tracker, and invoice reminder schedule searches.

products.name: Client Handoff Pack
products.product: A structured project-close workflow for delivering files, access, decisions, instructions, and open items to a service client.
products.audience: freelancers and independent professional service businesses
products.problem: Projects are called finished while files, credentials, ownership, maintenance instructions, and unresolved decisions remain across tools and conversations.
products.valueProposition: Builds a client-ready handoff index with acceptance, secure access transfer, training, open items, and closure evidence.
products.topic: freelancer client project handoff and offboarding checklists
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets client handoff checklist, project completion email, freelancer offboarding template, and website handover document searches.
